plastic_bottle: Empty it and replace the cap. Check local rules.
glass_jar: Rinse it. Many places want lids off.
aluminum_can: Empty it. No need to crush unless your area asks.
cardboard: Flatten it and keep it dry.
pizza_box: Greasy cardboard is usually not recyclable. Clean parts may be. Check local rules.
plastic_bag: Usually not curbside. Return to a store drop-off.
battery: Never in household bins. Use a battery or hazardous waste drop-off.
coffee_cup: Plastic-lined cups are usually not recyclable.
food_scraps: Compost if your area collects it, otherwise trash.
electronics: Use an e-waste collection point. Never in household bins.
